conclusion: Classification weights require workspace owner or explicit workspace member permissions to download. Under the current authorized API credentials, weights download is barred by Roboflow's access control policy (GraphMethodException). Consequently, the production-grade hosted adapter via InferenceHTTPClient (serverless.roboflow.com) with header authentication, permission guards (ATTUNE_ALLOW_HOSTED_INFERENCE=1), and differentiated error codes is the active, verified integration path for 4-class skin type.
